goal: Turn Graph from an append-only expander into an R1 structural selector under the same visible budget.

evidenceAuthority.claim: This Goal may select or reject an R1 mechanism; it cannot establish blind product value.

hypothesis.statement: Weighted random-walk-with-restart over a bounded audited relation subgraph can replace low-value lexical Seeds while preserving strong textual anchors, improving evidence coverage or reducing total context cost without hard regressions.
borrowedFromCodeGraph: RWR is computed only on an already bounded relevant subgraph.
A relevance gate prevents the budget ceiling from becoming a fill target.
Explicit high-confidence entry points are protected from structural demotion.
wgeSpecificConstraints: Only current relationAuditVersion edges may participate.
Relation type and conditions affect edge eligibility/weight.
Non-safety expansion requires at least two independent lexical anchors.
Every selected Claim remains an indivisible Claim+conditions+provenance+Evidence unit.

frozenSelectorConfig.visibleBudgetPolicy: R1 receives no budget beyond R0; Graph must rank or replace, not append.

offlineEntryGate: R1 and R0 use the same corpus, question, Claim limit and visible token budget.
R1 differs from R0 on at least one target question for an auditable structural reason.
Direct-fact and insufficient controls do not gain unrelated Claims.
All selected Claims retain complete Evidence closure and all visible Relations retain both endpoints.
No benchmark ID, source filename, domain keyword list or Gold field is read by the selector.

required: No additional hard failure relative to R0.
R1 is Pareto-nondominated by R0 on paired answer quality and actual total cost.
At least one target case has a traceable benefit caused by replacement/ranking rather than extra context.

possibleDecisions.GO: Micro establishes an explainable Pareto improvement; proceed to A/B/C Dev Core.
possibleDecisions.NARROW: Only a typed query/edge slice benefits; keep R1 scoped to that slice.
possibleDecisions.REWORK: No reliable benefit; preserve offline Graph governance and return to ranking/edge-substrate diagnosis.
